No binding is a verdict, a verified race or an upstream defect claim; every reject is a candidate for a future checker.

derivation.decision: user decision 2026-09-28: thread identity is derived statically from the call graph back to each thread's entry, as deep as possible; anything unresolved stays Unknown

hop_kinds.A: acutest test table: main -> TEST_LIST (tests/runtime/in_tail.c:3230) -> test function pointer; acutest forks a child per test by default (acutest.h:1123), so T is the child's main thread
hop_kinds.S: spawn-argument flow: a function pointer carried through a heap record to the new thread (mk_worker_start.callback, mk_utils.c:307 -> :290; for I also flb_tp_thread.params.func, flb_thread_pool.c:84 -> :123, and flb_worker.func, flb_worker.c:60 -> :43)
hop_kinds.V: plugin vtable: ins->p->cb_* resolved from the static initializer in_tail_plugin (plugins/in_tail/tail.c:867)
hop_kinds.V*: runtime vtable replacement: the revised test copies the plugin into T's stack (`test.plugin = *ins->p`, tests/runtime/in_tail.c:2554), overrides cb_pre_run (:2555) and publishes it through ins->p (:2556) before flb_start; resolving it needs field-sensitive flow of a stack struct copy published to another thread
hop_kinds.R: collector registry: coll->cb_collect resolved from the flb_input_set_collector_* call sites that register it
hop_kinds.L: loop dispatch: an event is dispatched by the thread that waits on its loop (mk_event_wait on config->evl by E, on thi->evl by I), and the fd-to-collector match (flb_input_collector_fd / input_collector_fd) selects the collector
hop_kinds.F: threaded-flag fork: flb_input_is_threaded(ins) is runtime configuration (property `threaded`); the derivation forks both values, and a discharge needs the premise that the flag is immutable after init so the same value selects coll->evl and the pause branch; the tests fix it by literals passed to flb_input_set

unresolved: V* (runtime plugin replacement through T's stack) is the one hop the revised test's C1-C4 events need beyond the resolvable kinds; a derivation without field-sensitive flow of the stack copy leaves B41-B43 and the revised-test paths of B10, B11, B13, B14, B26-B30 and B34-B38 Unknown, and NC2 then gives no conclusion rather than candidate-satisfying

F is decided per instance only by configuration data flow (the literal `threaded`, `true` in the threaded test); without it both threads are attributed, which suffices to refuse but not to discharge; a discharge also needs the flag-immutability premise

any function pointer outside the hop kinds A, S, V, R, L (processors, notification delivery, scheduler timer callbacks, output flush coroutines, other plugins' callbacks) stays Unknown; none is on the C1-C5 events bound here, but the flb_input_chunk.c append path reaches processor callbacks
coroutine inputs (runs_in_coroutine) resume on the dispatching thread only by premise; in_tail is not a coroutine input (flags 0, tail.c:878), so the census does not need it
acutest's fork-per-test puts each test in its own process; process identity is outside the thread model and is stated as a premise, not derived

happens-before is not derived by any hop: a resolved thread says who runs an event, never how two threads' events are ordered (the pipe hand-offs flb_engine_started -> do_start and the worker command pipe, and the mutex edges, are C4/C5's subject)

survey.evidence: pthread_mutex.qv and threads.qv state custody only ('Nothing about mutual exclusion, lock ordering, ...'); no resource-v1 predicate names a thread, loop owner or happens-before edge

docs/agents/concurrency.md constraint 27: condition variables are represented refusals of the mutex model. The libc provider still declares cnd_wait/cnd_timedwait as custody-only (borrowed) calls, which says nothing about wait semantics

no .qv/.qcore under providers/ or contract/ declares pthread_create, pthread_join or any pthread_cond_* function (they appear only in providers/quirin-provider-libc/libc-names.txt, the reserved-name list)
